name: license-check
description: Flags npm packages without a license field and repositories without a LICENSE file.

rules.title: npm package without a license field
rules.what: A package.json has no usable license field.
rules.why: Unlicensed dependencies create legal uncertainty about redistribution.
rules.fix: Add an SPDX license expression to the package.json license field.

rules.title: No LICENSE file at the repository root
rules.what: The scanned root has no LICENSE file.
rules.why: Consumers look for a top-level license to understand their rights.
rules.fix: Add a LICENSE file with the project's license text.
